title: MissionOutcome
description: The root of mission-outcome.json: the latest mission as it ended, written again once its salvage is final.

modVersion.description: The four-part version of the mod that wrote the file; the other files match the catalog written by the same version.

exportedAt.description: When the file was last written.

trigger.description: What caused the export that last wrote the file.

contract.description: The contract the mission was for.

state.description: Whether the contract was completed, retreated from or failed.

isGoodFaithEffort.description: Whether a retreated or failed contract still counts as a good faith effort, which softens its penalties.

rounds.description: The combat rounds the mission took, counted from 1.

objectives.description: The objectives as the after-action report lists them.

pay.description: The C-Bills paid, with the good faith modifier and the bonuses applied.

reputation.description: The final reputation changes with the employer, the target and the Mercenary Review Board.

experiencePerPilot.description: The experience every pilot of lance gets.

lance.description: The company's mechs and pilots on the mission, in lance order.

salvage.description: The salvage offer, and what the company got once it is final.

MissionContract.description: The contract a mission was for.

id.description: The contract's data file; null when the game keeps no reference to it.

name.description: The contract's name, as the contract list shows it.

type.description: The mission type, described in rules.json contractTypes.

displayStyle.description: Whether it's a regular, story, restoration or flashpoint contract.

employer.description: The faction that hires the company.

target.description: The faction the mission is fought against; INVALID_UNSET, which has no catalog.json factionDefinitions entry, for a story contract that only travels.

difficulty.description: On the scale of rules.json reputationLevels[].maxContractDifficulty, not the 1-10 the skulls show (two per skull).

starSystem.description: The star system the mission is fought in.

DefinitionReference.description: A game definition: its id from the game's data files and the name shown in the UI.

id.description: The id it's referred to by: for a definition its id from the game's data files, or its name in the game's enumeration where it has no data file (e.g. the player's faction), for a mech in the mech bay or a pilot the game's own id of it.

ContractDisplayStyle.description: Whether a contract is a regular, story, restoration or flashpoint contract.

ContractState.description: Where a contract stands, or how its mission ended.

ObjectiveResult.description: An objective as the after-action report lists it.

id.description: The game's id of the objective: a contract objective, which groups the objectives the HUD showed, or one of those where it has results of its own.

objectiveIds.description: Never empty: the ids combat-state.json objectives[].id had for the objectives this one groups, also those the HUD didn't list; its own id alone where it is one of them or groups none.

title.description: The objective's title as plain text.

isPrimary.description: Whether the after-action report lists it as a primary objective.

status.description: The objective's game status, e.g. Succeeded, Failed, or Active for one left unresolved.

MissionReputationChange.description: A mission's reputation changes, which also move the Mercenary Review Board rating.

employer.description: The change, usually a gain, with the employer; null when the employer doesn't gain reputation.

target.description: The change, usually a loss, with the target; null when the target doesn't gain reputation.

mercenaryReviewBoard.description: The change of the Mercenary Review Board rating.

LanceUnitOutcome.description: A mech and its pilot after the mission.

pilot.description: The pilot who fought in the mech.

injuries.description: The pilot's injuries, including those from before the mission.

health.description: The injuries the pilot can take before being incapacitated.

isIncapacitated.description: Whether the pilot was incapacitated: injuries reached health, or a lethal injury such as the mech's head destroyed.

isKilled.description: Whether the pilot died; an incapacitated pilot may survive.

pilotReadyOnDay.description: The day the pilot is out of the med bay, as the barracks counts it once the contract is resolved; null when the pilot is uninjured or killed.

mechKills.description: The enemy mechs the pilot destroyed in this mission.

otherKills.description: The other enemy units the pilot destroyed in this mission.

mech.description: The mech, as in the mech bay.

isMechLost.description: Whether the mech was destroyed and not recovered; its surviving components are in MissionSalvage.automatic.

repair.description: What repairing the mech's damage in the mech bay would take, as for a mech bay mech's game-state.json mechs[].repair; null when the mech is undamaged or lost.

damagedLocations.description: The locations that lost armor or structure, from head to legs.

ammunition.description: The shots fired from every ammunition box and every weapon that carries its own ammunition, in the mech's component order.

PilotReference.description: A pilot: their id, full name without callsign, and callsign.

id.description: The id it's referred to by: for a definition its id from the game's data files, or its name in the game's enumeration where it has no data file (e.g. the player's faction), for a mech in the mech bay or a pilot the game's own id of it.

callsign.description: The pilot's callsign, which isn't part of name.

MechReference.description: A mech in the mech bay, by its own id and name there (game-state.json mechs).

id.description: The id it's referred to by: for a definition its id from the game's data files, or its name in the game's enumeration where it has no data file (e.g. the player's faction), for a mech in the mech bay or a pilot the game's own id of it.

RepairEstimate.description: What the mech bay's Repair would take if ordered now, as its confirmation shows it.

days.description: The days the mech lab needs for the repair alone; it works on one order at a time, so an order queued behind others finishes later.

DamagedLocation.description: A body location that lost armor or structure in the mission, as it is after it.

armor.description: The armor left and fitted, by side.

structure.description: The structure left: below the chassis' when damaged, zero when destroyed.

front.description: The front armor; outside the torso, the location's only armor.

rear.description: The rear armor; null when the location is outside the torso, which alone has it.

Armor.description: The armor of one side of a location.

current.description: What is left after combat damage; refilled to assigned after a mission unless the location was destroyed.

assigned.description: The armor fitted in the mech lab.

DamagedComponent.description: A component damaged or destroyed in the mission.

component.description: The component, by the id its definition is keyed by.

location.description: The location it is mounted in.

damageLevel.description: The component's damage level, e.g. Penalized or Destroyed.

ComponentReference.description: A reference to a component's definition, with its type. Components are ordered by type, then by name, with the id breaking ties.

id.description: The id it's referred to by: for a definition its id from the game's data files, or its name in the game's enumeration where it has no data file (e.g. the player's faction), for a mech in the mech bay or a pilot the game's own id of it.

type.description: The game's component type, e.g. Weapon or AmmunitionBox, which names the component's group in catalog.json componentDefinitions; never NotSet, Special or MechPart, which the game's enum also has.

ComponentType.description: The game's kind of component, which names the component's group in catalog.json componentDefinitions.

AmmunitionUse.description: The shots a mech fired from an ammunition box, or from a weapon that carries its own ammunition.

component.description: The component, by the id its definition is keyed by.

location.description: The location the box or weapon is mounted in.

shotsFired.description: The shots fired, also from a box destroyed since; the capacity is catalog.json componentDefinitions.ammunitionBoxes.*.capacity or catalog.json componentDefinitions.weapons.*.internalAmmoCapacity.

MissionSalvage.description: The salvage of the mission: the offer as the mission ended, and what the company got once it is final.

total.description: How many items of pool the company gets.

priority.description: How many of them the company picks itself; the rest are drawn at random from what is left.

automatic.description: The surviving components of the company's own lost mechs, which it gets back on top of total.

received.description: Everything the company gets: the priority salvage, the salvage drawn at random and automatic; null when the salvage isn't final yet.

SalvageItems.description: Salvage items, counted like game-state.json storage, where they end up.

components.description: Their StoredComponent.damagedCount is 0: the game generates no damaged salvage.

mechParts.description: The mech parts, by the mech they assemble into.

component.description: The component, by the id its definition is keyed by.

count.description: The working copies; the damaged ones are in damagedCount.

damagedCount.description: The damaged copies, which need a repair once mounted.

StoredMechParts.description: Stored parts of a mech, from which the mech is assembled.

mech.description: The mech the parts assemble into, described in catalog.json mechDefinitions.
